# hetznerrobot_rdns (Data Source)

Reads the reverse DNS entry of one IP address.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hetznerrobot_rdns" "main" {
  ip = "123.123.123.123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) IP address.

### Read-Only

- `ptr` (String) PTR record.
